snippet.title: Million Depth | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2555950/Million_Depth/
Million Depth, where parallel worlds intersect in deep descent action strategy, is out now!
https://www.youtube.com/shorts/-iIwix3OSDg

【Story】
In the million layer underground world known as Million Depth, there exists a “you” whom a girl Moma is desperately searching for. However, that identity changes in each world line, and so does the fate that awaits her.

Decisions made in the past create unexpected consequences in the future, intertwining with events from alternate timelines. As you gather fragmented pieces of truth along the way, the mysteries of this world gradually unravel.

Developer: Cyber Space Biotope　Publisher: PLAYISM
